lastCompletedStory.title: Persist sidecar pid at spawn so cam stop can kill it

nextStoryContext: US-001 complete: sidecar pid is now written to .claude/.cam-sidecar.pid on spawn, and cam stop reads/kills/removes it. Next story should continue with CAM-67 requirements.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.Subprocess.pid is documented as readonly pid: number in the TypeScript interface. proc.pid is available immediately after Bun.spawn returns. Implementation confirmed correct.
